## Claim and scope

What does this establish: a full-budget candidate, local improvement, proof/audit,
checker change, or bounded negative result? State the exact claim and limitations.

## Baseline and changed mechanism

Name the predecessor commit/package, mathematical source, and task or discussion.
Explain the substantive change and which constraints it affects.

## Evidence and replay

Link exact inputs, certificate or proof, search limits/seeds, and commands with
their observed outcomes. List any checks not run. For numerical packages, include
the generated receipt and run `make check` and `git diff --check`.

## Open obligations and next question

What still needs review? Give one useful next step or handoff.

## Credit and assistance

Credit predecessor and concurrent work, identify substantial AI assistance, and
retain source licenses. Contributions are submitted under Apache-2.0.
